mapper.sql: schedule_id, company_name, job_title, job_url, employment_type, company_type, start_date, end_date, description, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM job_schedule ORDER BY end_date ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO job_schedule (company_name, job_title, job_url, employment_type, company_type, start_date, end_date, description) VALUES (#{companyName}, #{jobTitle}, #{jobUrl}, #{employmentType}, #{companyType}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{description})
mapper.update: UPDATE job_schedule SET company_name = #{companyName}, job_title = #{jobTitle}, job_url = #{jobUrl}, employment_type = #{employmentType}, company_type = #{companyType}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, description = #{description} WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId}
